strings.convert.intro.body: enough doesn’t display {kind} directly. When you open {name}, enough writes a markdown twin beside it — {name}.md — and the twin is what you read and edit here. Your original is never touched until you choose export changes, which either overwrites it (with undo) or writes a new datestamped copy next to it.
strings.convert.intro.engineMissingBody: enough can’t read {kind} yet — that takes the PDF extra: the document reader plus its layout and table models. Budget about 250 MB to download and about 1 GB on disk, plus about 0.7 GB of model weights the first time. Writing PDFs already ships with enough; this extra is only for reading them (and PowerPoint decks and Excel workbooks).
